look_here_first: Check four sharp stem wings created by sessile leaf bases running down the stem; alternate lanceolate leaves and 4 yellow petals with 8 stamens confirm.

morphology_keys.habit: Erect, branching annual or short-lived wetland herb; strongly four-angled, winged stems.
morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate, lanceolate or linear-lanceolate, usually sessile; leaf bases decurrent along stem.
morphology_keys.flower: Usually 4 bright yellow petals and 8 stamens; ovary inferior.
morphology_keys.fruit: Obconic to narrowly pyramidal capsule, sharply 4-angled or winged.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Against Ludwigia octovalvis, look for true broad wings running down the stem from sessile leaves; ordinary stem ridges alone are not decisive.
